title:
The epic listens for 'CELL_ACTION_CLICK_PLOT_FEATURES' action containing a specific payload structure.
When it detects a valid `appStateField` and corresponding value in the action payload,
it dispatches an action to update the filter panel with the selected failure mode.
If the required data is missing or invalid, the epic emits nothing.
name: UpdateFilterPanelFromFailureModesGridEpic
